title: Book the Beachview Rosemary Beach Cottage | Rosemary Beach Vacation Rental – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Beachview Cottage seamlessly blends interior to exterior with porch and courtyard spaces and a floor plan meant for family gatherings. Click to book this beautiful rental today!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Welcome to Beachview Cottage & Carriage House, a stunning retreat just off the Gulf, offering breathtaking Gulf views from all floors. This exquisite property seamlessly blends indoor and outdoor living with its charming porches, courtyard spaces, and a thoughtfully designed floor plan perfect for family gatherings.

First Floor: Enter through the soaring foyer that leads to four guest bedrooms:

Guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom with two separate single vanities, and a walk-in shower
2 nd guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom with a single vanity and walk-in shower
Guest bedroom with two twin beds - would use the shared bathroom with the bunk room featuring a double vanity and large walk-in shower
Bunk room featuring a twin over full - would use the shared bathroom with the twin room featuring a double vanity and large walk-in shower

Second Floor: The main living space opens up on the second floor, complete with a balcony overlooking the courtyard and pool area, providing marvelous views of the Gulf. The master bedroom on this floor boasts a king bed, a private balcony, and an en suite bathroom with a double vanity, large soaking tub, and walk-in shower. Additionally, there's a convenient half bath and a staircase leading to the third-floor crows nest, which offers panoramic Gulf views.

Outdoor Living: Step outside to find a pergola overlooking the stunning private pool, a porch extending the length of the home wrapping around along the boardwalk, an outdoor grill, and plenty of entertainment space for the entire family to gather.

Carriage House: The carriage house features:

A private king bedroom and a loft with a full-size bed.
A first-floor living space and a shared bathroom.
A wrap-around balcony with views of the courtyard and glimpses of the Gulf.

Beachview Cottage and Carriage House is the ideal destination for those seeking a perfect balance of family gathering space and stunning views of the beautiful Gulf of Mexico.

Garage Parking for two vehicles.

**THIS PROPERTY REQUIRES A 7 NIGHT RENTAL SATURDAY - SATURDAY YEAR ROUND**

Pool can be heated October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee.
